name: WebCrawlerAPI Agent
description: AI-powered web crawling and scraping agent. Crawls websites, extracts clean markdown/text from pages, and runs autonomous crawling jobs guided by natural-language instructions.

bearerAuth.description: API key issued from the WebCrawlerAPI dashboard, sent as a Bearer token.

skills.name: Scrape a page
skills.description: Fetches a single URL with a headless browser and returns its content as clean markdown, text, or HTML.

skills.name: Crawl a website
skills.description: Crawls a website starting from a seed URL, following links up to configured depth/limits, and returns extracted content for every page.
examples: Crawl https://example.com and collect all docs pages as markdown

skills.name: Autonomous crawling agent
skills.description: Runs an AI agent that browses a website autonomously, following a natural-language prompt to find and extract the requested information.
examples: Find pricing info on https://example.com and summarize it
